:::{#def-predicate-notation}
#### Predicate notation for indicators

An indicator (@def-indicator-function) is written in **predicate notation**
when a proposition or predicate $P$ ([definition](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/proof-writing.html#def-predicate)) appears as its [argument](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-argument),
as in $\indicp{P}$ or $\indicp{x \in A}$.

:::
